name: Probes, lifecycle & graceful shutdown
objective: CKAD › Application Design and Build + Observability. Drill EVERY pod-design corner harder than the exam: classic vs native sidecars, init ordering, all three probe types and handlers, lifecycle hooks + graceful shutdown, full securityContext hardening, QoS classes, the Downward API, and a no-hint diagnose-and-fix. Graded exactly, per requirement.

questions.title: All three probe types, three handlers
questions.teach:
Three probe kinds: **livenessProbe** restarts a failing container, **readinessProbe** pulls it from Service endpoints, **startupProbe** gates the other two until a slow app is up. Any probe uses one of three handlers: `exec`, `httpGet`, or `tcpSocket`.

**Gotcha:** timing fields (`periodSeconds`, `initialDelaySeconds`, `failureThreshold`) attach per-probe — set each on the right probe.
questions.prompt:
Create pod `health-pod` in `pod-design` (`nginx:1.25`, one container `web`) with all three probes:
- **livenessProbe**: `exec` running `["sh","-c","ls /usr/share/nginx/html"]`, `periodSeconds=15`.
- **readinessProbe**: `httpGet` path `/` port `80`, `initialDelaySeconds=5`.
- **startupProbe**: `tcpSocket` port `80`, `failureThreshold=30`, `periodSeconds=10`.
questions.hint: All three go under the same container. Use `exec.command` for liveness, `httpGet` for readiness, `tcpSocket` for startup — mind the exact timing fields.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: health-pod, namespace: pod-design }
spec:
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.25
    livenessProbe:
      exec: { command: ["sh","-c","ls /usr/share/nginx/html"] }
      periodSeconds: 15
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet: { path: /, port: 80 }
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
    startupProbe:
      tcpSocket: { port: 80 }
      failureThreshold: 30
      periodSeconds: 10
YAML

questions.title: Lifecycle hooks + graceful shutdown
questions.teach:
**Lifecycle hooks** on a container run code around its life: `lifecycle.postStart` fires right after the container starts, `lifecycle.preStop` fires before SIGTERM on shutdown. `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` (on the pod `spec`) is how long preStop + SIGTERM get before SIGKILL.

**Gotcha:** a `preStop` that runs longer than `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` is cut off by SIGKILL.
questions.prompt:
Create pod `graceful-pod` in `pod-design` (`nginx:1.25`, container `web`) with:
- `lifecycle.postStart` exec `["sh","-c","echo started > /tmp/poststart"]`
- `lifecycle.preStop` exec `["sh","-c","nginx -s quit"]`
- `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30`
questions.hint: `lifecycle.postStart.exec.command` and `lifecycle.preStop.exec.command` live on the container; `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` lives on the pod `spec`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: graceful-pod, namespace: pod-design }
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx:1.25
    lifecycle:
      postStart: { exec: { command: ["sh","-c","echo started > /tmp/poststart"] } }
      preStop: { exec: { command: ["sh","-c","nginx -s quit"] } }
YAML

verification.description: graceful-pod: postStart + preStop exec hooks + terminationGracePeriodSeconds 30
